PH marketplaces for commodity items: Vention Cat6 patch cables, Kingston SSDs (official Kingston store — the PH market has counterfeit portable SSDs, so buy from the brand store only), C14 adapter plugs, generic PoE→USB-C adapters, the UACC-Adapter-PoE-USBC, velcro ties.

Always confirm the listing matches the spec (e.g. an adapter does power *and* data) before ordering.
